releases.body:
Three-Part Historical Docudrama Premieres for Thanksgiving 2026 

NEW YORK, Oct. 27, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- FOX Nation has partnered with Academy Award winner and Landman star Billy Bob Thornton for the new original three-part docudrama event Billy Bob Thornton Presents: The Mayflower, premiering November 23, 2026, announced Lauren Petterson, president of FOX Nation. Hosted by Thornton, the series revisits one of America's most enduring origin stories, revealing the complex history of the Mayflower voyage, the First Thanksgiving and the events that forever shaped our nation. A first look from episode one is available here. 

In making the announcement, Petterson said, "Billy Bob Thornton is a captivating storyteller with a unique ability to bring history to life. The Mayflower offers a fresh and thought-provoking perspective on one of the most familiar chapters in American history, giving viewers a richer understanding of the people, conflicts and events that shaped our nation's beginnings." 

Spanning three episodes, Billy Bob Thornton Presents: The Mayflower traces the Pilgrims' perilous Atlantic crossing aboard the Mayflower, the fragile alliance forged between the English settlers and the Wampanoag people, and the devastating conflict that ultimately transformed Britain's colonies into the earliest foundations of an American identity. 

Academy Award-winning writer, actor, director and musician Billy Bob Thornton has an extensive and impressive career in motion pictures, television, and theater. Charismatic and uniquely talented, Thornton has established himself as one of the most sought-after filmmakers and actors of his generation. Currently celebrating a high-water mark in his career, Thornton is starring in the hit Paramount+ series "Landman," for which he received Critics' Choice Award and Golden Globe Award nominations for Best Actor in a Television Drama. His recent projects have also included the Amazon series Goliath, for which his performance received rave reviews and garnered him a Golden Globe Award for Best Actor in a Television Drama; the critically acclaimed FX Network limited television series Fargo, for which he received Golden Globe and Broadcast Television Critics Awards for Best Actor in a miniseries or Movie, and Emmy and SAG Award nominations in the same category. He garnered a Golden Globe nomination for Best Actor in a Musical or Comedy for his role in the critically acclaimed box-office hit "Bad Santa," and received rave reviews for his portrayal of legendary frontiersman Davy Crockett in Touchstone Pictures' "The Alamo." Showing the versatility of his acting abilities, Thornton starred in the caper comedy "Bandits"; the film noir "The Man Who Wasn't There"; and the drama "Monster's Ball." Each of the three performances garnered Thornton unprecedented critical acclaim and resulted in him being named Best Actor of 2001 by the National Board of Review, Golden Globe nominations for Best Actor in a Drama for "The Man Who Wasn't There" and Best Actor in a Musical or Comedy for "Bandits," and an American Film Institute Award nomination for Best Actor for "The Man Who Wasn't There."  Thornton's release of the critically acclaimed feature film "Sling Blade," which he starred in and directed from an original script he wrote, firmly secured his status as a preeminent filmmaker. For his efforts, he was honored with both an Academy Award for Best Adapted Screenplay and an Academy Award nomination for Best Actor. In addition, Thornton received an Academy Award nomination and Golden Globe nomination for Best Supporting Actor for his celebrated work in the drama "A Simple Plan," as well as a Best Supporting Actor award from the Los Angeles Film Critics Association and a Best Supporting Actor nomination from the Screen Actors Guild.  He also co-starred in the blockbuster action-adventure film Armageddon. Thornton will next be seen starring in the highly anticipated dramatic feature film "Somedays."

In developing the series, the team consulted a range of historical resources and experts, including historians at Plimoth Patuxet Museums, where portions of the series were filmed, as well as acclaimed historian Nathaniel Philbrick, author of the Pulitzer Prize finalist Mayflower: A Story of Courage, Community, and War. Praising the project's effort to introduce this pivotal chapter of American history to a new audience, Philbrick said, "The voyage of the Mayflower set into motion what would become the United States. Kudos to Billy Bob Thornton for helping to bring this vital story from America's past to life."

The series is produced by AIRtime Projects and Terminal B TV with executive producers Billy Bob Thornton, Geyer Kosinski, Tom Forman, David Metzler, Jordan Rosenblum and showrunner and executive producer John Ealer.

NEW YORK, Oct. 23, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- FOX News Media will provide special multiplatform coverage of the 2026 midterm elections on Tuesday, November 3rd and throughout the surrounding days. Beginning at 6 PM/ET, FOX News Channel (FNC) will kick off November 3rd's election night coverage with FOX News Democracy 26, co-anchored by Bret Baier, chief political anchor and executive editor of Special Report, and Martha MacCallum, anchor and executive editor of The Story.

Appearing alongside Baier and MacCallum throughout the evening will be FNC's Dana Perino, Brit Hume, Harold Ford Jr., Bill Hemmer, Sandra Smith, Laura Ingraham, Jesse Watters, Sean Hannity, Trace Gallagher, Harris Faulkner, Kayleigh McEnany and Jessica Tarlov. The program will provide viewers with the latest calls on House, Senate and gubernatorial races, as well as projections on the balance of power in both the Senate and the House via the FOX News Decision Desk. Gallagher will then take over coverage through 4 AM/ET, when a special early edition of FOX & Friends First begins. Notably, FOX Business Network (FBN) will simulcast FNC's coverage starting at 6 PM/ET on Tuesday, November 3rd until 6 AM/ET on Wednesday, November 4th.

For this year's election coverage, FNC will expand its use of augmented reality and data-driven graphics to provide viewers with a deeper understanding of election results as they unfold. Enhanced visualizations will illustrate county-level voting shifts compared to previous elections, track the balance of power in Congress and provide additional context around key races. The network will also showcase versatile graphics packages, templates and automated production processes, allowing teams to respond quickly to breaking developments while building technology that can be utilized across future election cycles.

Contributing to FNC's election coverage from Washington D.C. will be senior White House correspondents Jacqui Heinrich and Peter Doocy and White House correspondent Aishah Hasnie. Additionally, over 20 FNC and FBN correspondents will provide on the ground coverage from states across the country where key Senate, House and gubernatorial races are taking place. Correspondents and locations include Bryan Llenas and Alexis McAdams in Maine, Molly Line in New Hampshire, Eric Shawn in New York, Mark Meredith in North Carolina, Steve Harrigan in South Carolina, Madison Scarpino in Georgia, Madison Alworth and Alexandria Hoff in Ohio, Connor Hansen, Rich Edson and Garrett Tenney in Michigan, Bill Melugin in Minnesota, Grady Trimble in Iowa, Mike Tobin, Brooke Taylor and Alicia Acuna in Texas, Max Gorden in California, Matt Finn in Alaska, Nate Foy in Kansas and Danamarie McNicholl in Florida. FNC's chief congressional correspondent Chad Pergram will also report live from Capitol Hill.

In addition to the network's election night programming, The Ruthless Podcast, co-hosted by Josh Holmes, Michael Duncan and John Ashbrook, along with Shashank Tripathi, pseudonymously known as "Comfortably Smug," will helm an election night special entitled Ruthless Live! Midterm Election Show live from Washington, D.C. Viewers will be able to stream the show live from 8-11 PM/ET on FOX News Digital (FND) and FOX Nation.

In the days leading up to November 3rd, FNC weekday hosts and anchors will deliver special episodes of their shows beginning on Sunday, November 1st with a two-hour edition of Outnumbered (12-2 PM/ET). Also on Sunday, Baier and MacCallum will host an election preview special entitled FOX News Democracy 26 from 3-4 PM/ET. On Monday, November 2nd, FOX News @ Night will air for an extra hour (11 PM/ET - 1 AM/ET). The network's programming on Tuesday will feature prominent guests and analysis throughout the day ahead of the election night special at 6 PM/ET.

During the week before the election, coast-to-coast host of FOX & Friends Steve Doocy will take his signature "Breakfast with Friends" segment on the road again for a special election series, connecting with voters at diners in swing states across the nation. Doocy will kick off the tour on October 26th from JC's Restaurant in Burton, Ohio followed by Four Corners Diner in Romeo, Michigan on October 27th. He will broadcast from Keys Cafe & Bakery in Roseville, Minnesota on October 28th, and from Bubba's Cooks Country in Dallas, Texas on October 29th. Doocy's final stop will be at Big Doug's Place in Hiram, Georgia on October 30th. On October 31st, FOX & Friends First co-host Todd Piro will pick up the "Breakfast with Friends" tour live from Stacks Pancake House in Scarborough, Maine. On the morning of Election Day, the tour will conclude with a diner stop hosted by FOX & Friends Weekend co-hosts Charles Hurt and Griff Jenkins.

FOX News Digital will deliver comprehensive coverage of the midterm elections, featuring dedicated, original reporting on major Senate, House and gubernatorial contests across the country. The platform will also showcase a live blog, FOX News Power Rankings, which will track results and deliver breaking developments in real time throughout the evening as polls close. The live blog will also incorporate FOX News Voter Analysis, which provides a comprehensive look at voting behavior, opinions, and preferences as America votes.

Additionally, the FOX News App will debut a new "Midterms 2026" tab, harnessing AI-powered technology to deliver in-depth race insights. This will include county-level election data that users can explore on an interactive map and a new "Election HQ" feature, which will introduce an AI-powered election chatbot designed to help users navigate the latest developments and better understand election results as they unfold. Drawing directly from FOX News reporting, the chatbot will provide real-time answers to user questions about key races, results and issues, making it easier to access relevant information throughout the evening. Signed-in users can also participate in "The Room," an interactive experience designed to mimic the lively, water-cooler style election night commentary popular on platforms like X.

On Election Day, FOX News Audio will present live, wall-to-wall coverage airing across FOX News Radio (FNR) affiliates and through the FOX News App "Listen" button. Co-anchors Jared Halpern and Jessica Rosenthal will kick off live programming at 7PM/ET, featuring expert political analysis and field reports from the FNC & FNR correspondents tracking battleground races nationwide. Live victory and concession speeches will be fed out to affiliates as results are announced. Following Election Day, FOX News Audio will recap the night with a one-hour special which will be available to listeners on FNR and through the FOX News App at 8 AM/ET.

Additionally, FOX News Audio will offer pre-Election Day programming with FOX News Headlines 24/7 on SiriusXM Satellite Radio providing the latest updates on midterm and gubernatorial races every 15 minutes. FNR will be offering affiliates daily political updates in nationally syndicated five-minute (top of the hour) and one-minute (bottom of the hour) newscasts. FNR will also provide affiliates with live feeds of rallies and political events across the country.

Leading up to Election Day, FOX News Podcasts will offer special episodes from its staple shows and a Democracy '26 landing page will be available to listeners across FNA's digital and social platforms. Perino on Politics, The Bret Baier Podcast and The Untold Story with Martha MacCallum will feature a wide range of guests including top-tier strategists, industry leaders, politicians, tech titans, FOX News personalities, among other top newsmakers to discuss policies, practices, and solutions to the biggest issues of the day as November 3rd approaches. The FOX News Rundown will present a special five-part series, from October 26th to 30th, profiling the high-stakes states and showcasing top political analysts and strategists.

FOX News Media operates the FOX News Channel (FNC), FOX Business Network (FBN), FOX News Digital, FOX News Podcasts, FOX News Audio, FOX News Books, the direct-to-consumer streaming services FOX Nation, FOX News International and the free ad-supported television service FOX Weather. Currently the number one network in all of cable, FNC has also been the most watched television news channel for over 24 consecutive years, while FBN is the top business channel on cable. FOX News Media reaches nearly 200 million people each month and is also available to live stream on FOX One.

CALGARY, AB, Oct. 21, 2026 /CNW/ -- AlixPartners Restructuring, Inc., the Court-appointed Receiver of A Parent Media Co. Inc. ("APMC") and Kidoodle, Inc. ("Kidoodle", and together with APMC, the "Debtors"), is soliciting offers to purchase or invest in the Debtors' business and assets, including the Kidoodle.TV and Victory+ streaming platforms, pursuant to a Court-approved stalking horse sale and investment solicitation process (the "SISP").

BUSINESS OVERVIEW

  • APMC develops streaming, monetization and digital advertising technology in-house and operates in approximately 160 territories and regions.
  • Kidoodle.TV is a free, ad-supported, COPPA-compliant children's streaming service launched in 2014, with more than 26 million lifetime app downloads since 2024; the platform has remained online throughout the receivership.
  • Victory+ is a free, ad-supported live sports streaming service launched in 2024; the platform is currently offline.

KEY ASSETS

  • Kidoodle.TV and Victory+ streaming platforms, brands and related intellectual property.
  • Proprietary programmatic advertising stack and COPPA-compliant advertising proxy.
  • Data lake and first-party user data (subject to applicable privacy law), content and media rights contracts, computer equipment and accounts receivable.

THE OPPORTUNITY

  • The SISP seeks offers to purchase all or substantially all the Debtors' property, or to invest in, restructure, recapitalize or refinance the Debtors or their business.
  • Offers for portions of the Debtors' property are permitted if, alone or together with other offers, they constitute a Superior Offer (as defined in the SISP) to the stalking horse bid.
  • The bid deadline is 12:00 p.m. (Calgary time) on November 20, 2026.
  • Details on the SISP and the stalking horse bid are available at the case website (cdncases.alixpartners.com/experience/case/a-parent-media). Parties that sign a non-disclosure agreement will receive access to the virtual data room.

releases.body:
ADU design-build specialist Acton ADU to appear on All Access with Andy Garcia as an industry expert on how accessory dwelling units are reshaping housing for families across California and the United States

CAMPBELL, Calif., Oct. 20, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Accessory dwelling units are now one of the fastest-growing forms of housing in America, and Acton ADU is helping a national audience understand why. The California design-build company, which specializes exclusively in ADUs, was selected as an industry specialist for All Access with Andy Garcia, an educational series airing on Public Television stations nationwide. The segment explores the ADU movement and its growing impact on families and homeowners across California and the country.

The feature arrives as ADU growth hits record levels. California issued 41,831 ADU permits in 2025, an all-time high and a more than thirtyfold increase from the 1,336 permitted in 2016, with ADUs accounting for roughly a quarter of all new homes permitted statewide (California Department of Housing and Community Development Annual Progress Report data, as of the September 2026 release). In Los Angeles and San Francisco, more permits were issued for ADUs in 2025 than for all other forms of housing combined (Cotality, as of 2025). In Los Angeles County alone, a record 10,200+ ADUs were completed in 2025, accounting for 37 percent of the county's new housing (USC Lusk Center for Real Estate).

"The most important thing happening in California housing isn't downtown, it's in backyards," said Stan Acton, founder of Acton ADU. "Families are using ADUs to keep aging parents close, give adult children an affordable place to land, and build lasting value on property they already own. That's a generational shift in how Americans think about home, and it's why we were honored to help tell this story on Public Television."

In the segment, Acton ADU explains what ADUs are, why demand for backyard homes has accelerated, and how thoughtful small-home design determines whether an ADU performs for decades. The company also shares the thinking behind Family Integrity Planning, its framework for helping homeowners use ADUs to keep generations close, care for the people they love, and grow long-term value at home.

Founded on more than 35 years of residential construction experience, Acton ADU has completed hundreds of projects across California and serves homeowners throughout the San Francisco Bay Area, East Bay, San Gabriel Valley, and greater Los Angeles county.

The segment featuring Acton ADU will begin distribution on October 26, 2026 on more than 170 participating Public Television stations nationwide, and will air through October 2027.

Interview Availability

Acton ADU founder Stan Acton is available for media interviews on:

  • The ADU movement and California housing policy, including the rise of pre-approved ADU plans
  • Multigenerational living and Family Integrity Planning
  • Why designing a small home well is harder than designing a big one
  • What homeowners should know before building an ADU

To schedule an interview, contact James Parks at info@actonadu.com.

About Acton ADU

Acton ADU is a California design-build company specializing in accessory dwelling units. Serving homeowners throughout the San Francisco Bay Area, East Bay, and San Gabriel Valley, Acton ADU provides an all-in-one partnership covering feasibility, design, permitting, construction, and warranty. Every project is built to perform for decades, backed by a proven process built on No Surprises, Thoughtful Procedures, and Pride and Quality. Learn more at ActonADU.com.

From the Yankees clubhouse to baseball's looming labor showdown, Sturtze and host Shana Orczyk Sissel examine the money, power and financial risks reshaping professional sports.

LIVE TODAY: Tuesday, October 20, 2026 | 12:00 PM ET

WASHINGTON, Oct. 20, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- CrossCheck Media Inc. today announced that former Major League Baseball pitcher Tanyon Sturtze, who spent 12 seasons in the major leagues, including three with the New York Yankees, will appear live on Franchise Value today at 12:00 PM Eastern Time on Biz Talk Today TV (BTT).

The episode will stream live on the CrossCheck Media YouTube channel and across Biz Talk Today TV's distribution network.

Hosted by Shana Orczyk Sissel, CEO and Founder of Banríon Capital Management and author of Tough Minded, Franchise Value examines the increasingly sophisticated business of professional sports, where franchise valuations, labor negotiations, media rights and financial markets collide.

Today's episode brings an unusually revealing perspective to that conversation.

Sturtze experienced professional baseball from both ends of the financial spectrum. He was an Opening Day starter for the Tampa Bay Devil Rays, one of baseball's lowest-payroll organizations, before joining the New York Yankees and becoming a key member of manager Joe Torre's pitching staff.

His career offers firsthand insight into the financial realities facing professional athletes, from negotiating contracts and competing for roster spots to managing injuries that can abruptly change a player's earning potential.

Now working in the insurance industry, Sturtze brings a second perspective to the business of sports: how athletes, teams and financial institutions evaluate and manage risk.

Baseball's Billion-Dollar Labor Battle

The conversation arrives at a pivotal moment for Major League Baseball.

With the league's collective bargaining agreement scheduled to expire December 1, 2026, owners and players are confronting potentially consequential negotiations over salary caps, minimum payroll requirements, revenue sharing and the possibility of another work stoppage.

At the center of the debate is competitive balance.

The Tampa Bay Rays and Milwaukee Brewers are preparing to meet in the World Series despite operating with substantially smaller payrolls than many of baseball's biggest-market franchises.

Their success raises an important question: Does Major League Baseball need a salary cap to create competitive balance, or would a cap primarily give owners greater control over labor costs?

Sissel and Sturtze will explore that question through the experiences of a former player who competed for both a small-market organization and the New York Yankees.

Inside the Yankees Clubhouse

Beyond baseball's labor negotiations, viewers can expect a firsthand look at life inside one of professional sports' most recognizable franchises.

Sturtze will discuss his experiences in the major leagues, the differences between small-market and big-market organizations, and the financial pressures facing players whose careers depend on performance, health and contract negotiations.

The discussion will also examine how injuries can affect an athlete's financial future and why insurance and risk management have become increasingly important components of professional sports.

When Athletes Become Financial Assets

Today's episode will also explore a developing intersection between Wall Street and professional athletics.

From sports-related futures contracts and proposed investment funds to platforms offering investors exposure to athletes' future earnings, financial innovation is creating new ways to participate in the economics of professional sports.

But those developments raise significant questions about regulation, insider information, athlete compensation and financial risk.

Sissel and Sturtze will examine who benefits from these emerging financial products, who bears the risk and whether the athletes themselves are adequately protected.

The conversation will also touch on rising franchise valuations, media-rights economics and the expanding role of institutional capital in professional sports.

The professional T20 franchise tournament will take place in St. Vincent and the Grenadines from October 23 to November 1, 2026, before returning to Canada for its 2027. Hosting the 2026 tournament in the Caribbean before its return to Canada next year marks the beginning of a partnership that can facilitate the continued development of Canadian cricket while showcasing our region as one of the great cricketing regions of world cricket. As the only full member of the ICC in the hemisphere, we believe it is important to forge mutually beneficial relationships with ICC Associate Members across the region, for the health of the game and, indeed, for the continued development of West Indies cricket."

"Every ball, every six, every wicket -- live, coast to coast," said Malini Basu, Chief Global Communications Officer for NCL GT20. "This league was built for Canada, and with cricket headed to the 2028 Olympics, Canadian fans deserve a front-row seat to the players who will shape the sport's next chapter. We're excited to work with ATN to bring NCL GT20 to cricket fans across Canada" she added.

releases.title: CRTC takes action to improve information about cellphone coverage
releases.body:
GATINEAU, QC, Oct. 2, 2026 /CNW/ -- The CRTC is helping Canadians better understand where cellphone coverage is available and where there may be gaps.

Following a public consultation, the CRTC is introducing a new approach for how service providers report on their cellphone networks. This will give Canadians more detailed information about cellphone coverage in a specific area, making it easier to compare service options.

Canadians will also be able to report locations where coverage maps do not reflect their experience. This feedback will help improve the accuracy of information over time and provide a clearer picture of connectivity needs across Canada.

The CRTC collects data from service providers on their coverage and provides this information to Innovation, Science and Economic Development Canada (ISED), which uses it for its National Broadband Map. Better data will help service providers and governments identify areas where there are gaps, supporting planning and investments that improve connectivity.

The CRTC is also making it easier for Canadians to find, compare and choose the Internet and cellphone services that meet their needs. Recent measures include eliminating extra fees on Internet and cellphone plans, improving how Canadians are notified about expiring contracts and discounts, giving Canadians more ways to change or cancel their plans and making it easier to compare Internet plans.

Quotes

"Better information leads to better decisions. By improving how cellphone coverage is reported and giving Canadians a way to flag gaps, we can build a clearer picture of connectivity across the country and help support better investment where it is needed."

- Vicky Eatrides, Chairperson and Chief Executive Officer, CRTC

Quick facts

  • The CRTC is an independent quasi-judicial tribunal that regulates the Canadian communications sector in the public interest. The CRTC holds public consultations on telecommunications and broadcasting matters and makes decisions based on the public record.
  • The new standard will be phased in beginning with the next Annual Facilities Survey in early 2027.
  • The Consumer Protections Action Plan sets out the actions the CRTC is taking to protect and empower Canadians.

ENGLEWOOD CLIFFS, N.J., Oct. 2, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- LG Electronics (LG) announced a partnership with digital games leader Miniclip to launch the global hit mobile game 8 Ball Pool on LG Smart TVs, marking its first availability on the big screen. Recognized by Guinness World Records as the most downloaded mobile pool game, with more than 1 billion downloads worldwide, 8 Ball Pool will be available free-to-play on LG Smart TVs and monitors running webOS 6.0 and above in 165 countries, starting this week.

Bringing 8 Ball Pool to TV Screens

For its big-screen at-home debut, 8 Ball Pool has been optimized for the webOS platform with a dynamic user interface, allowing players to aim, adjust power and shoot with intuitive precision using the LG Magic Remote. The game also offers optional in-game items for purchase, adding opportunities for fun and personalization.

Recognizing the TV's unique role as the centerpiece of living room entertainment, LG and Miniclip are introducing the all-new Couch Play Mode, an exclusive feature for this release. This specialized mode adds 1-on-1 multiplayer gameplay, allowing two users to compete head-to-head on the same screen and bringing family and friends together for shared, competitive fun from the comfort of the sofa. To celebrate the launch, LG and Miniclip are offering exclusive items specially designed for LG TV users.

The game can be accessed via LG Apps or the LG Gaming Portal. In the Gaming Portal, users can also collect special rewards, such as badges in My Page, by completing tasks.

Advancing High-Quality Free Gaming to TV Screens

The launch of 8 Ball Pool further reinforces LG's continued momentum in TV gaming, bringing one of the most recognizable casual gaming experiences to the connected TV screen. With high-quality graphics, intuitive gameplay and free access, the title is expected to help drive stronger engagement across LG's gaming platform and support the continued evolution of CTV gaming into a more mainstream entertainment experience.

LG has tripled the number of web-based gaming titles available across its platform over the last two years1, expanding its library to more than 1,000 free-to-play games. This expanded library has contributed to stronger user engagement, with overall gaming usage increasing by 67 percent year over year2. Total hours played grew by 71 percent, while individual gaming sessions rose by 50 percent, underscoring the growing role of LG Smart TVs as an entertainment and gaming destination.

Delivering a Life-Size Experience at Home

On LG's screens over 100 inches, including LG's latest QNED evo and Micro RGB TVs, 8 Ball Pool comes to life at real-world scale3, creating an immersive at-home experience that players can enjoy with just a remote controller.

"Through this partnership, LG continues to expand its free premium gaming ecosystem on the webOS platform," said Chris Jo, head of the webOS Platform Business Center at the LG Media Entertainment Solution Company. "With new hit titles customized for big-screen players, LG is transforming the traditional TV into an interactive hub for home entertainment."

LG remains committed to enhancing LG Gaming Portal with compelling, new titles and convenient features, enabling users to enjoy the excitement of big-screen gaming directly on LG Smart TVs and Smart Monitors. To learn more, visit LG.com.

releases.title: Dunamis Woman™ Enterprise Expands Into Original Media With Launch of Dunamis Woman™ TV Network
releases.body:
Inc. 5000-ranked faith-based enterprise unveils new television and podcast slate led by original docuseries, "House of Healing." Private Atlanta upfront and premiere screening set for Thursday, October 8.

ATLANTA, Sept. 17, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Dunamis Woman™ Enterprise has announced they are expanding their transformational work into television and digital media with the launch of the Dunamis Woman™ TV Network, a new streaming platform featuring original programming centered on healing, faith, identity, relationships, leadership and personal transformation. The initial slate will include the flagship docuseries, House of Healing, the Dunamis Woman Today TV show and original podcasts from Dunamis Woman™ Visionary Founder, Dr. Davetta "Dunamis Dee" Mallory, and her daughter COO and Visionary Builder, Ariel "Professor Ari" Fuller.

The expansion marks the next chapter for the mother-daughter-led enterprise, whose story began with Dr. Dee and Professor Ari doing the deeply personal work to heal their own relationship before helping other women do the same. What began as a calling has since grown into a multimillion-dollar faith-based enterprise serving more than 125,000 women globally and, most recently, earning the company the No. 3,465 spot on the 2026 Inc. 5000 list following 82% three-year revenue growth.

"When Dunamis Woman began, healing was personal. My daughter and I had to confront things in our own relationship before we could authentically help other women confront what was broken in theirs," said Dr. Dunamis Dee. "Since then, we have had the privilege of watching women do the courageous work of healing, reclaiming their identity and changing the trajectory of their families. I am incredibly proud of how far this vision has come, and I believe we are ready for this next chapter. Dunamis Woman TV gives us an opportunity to open the doors and let the world see what real healing looks like, and what becomes possible on the other side of it."

"We reached a point where we knew the transformation happening within Dunamis Woman could no longer be limited by how many people we could bring into a room," added Ariel. "My mother is the Visionary Leader, and I am the Visionary Builder, so my responsibility was to determine how we could translate what she created into media without losing the integrity of what makes it powerful. That required us to think beyond simply filming content and intentionally develop programming that could carry these stories, conversations and experiences to a much larger audience. Dunamis Woman TV is the result of that planning, and the beginning of how we take this impact to the world." 

To extend that impact, the Dunamis Woman™ TV Network will serve as the centralized home for the organization's original television, transformational storytelling and podcasts, bringing its growing body of programming together across digital and streaming platforms. The network's slate includes:

Dunamis Woman Today — Premieres Wednesday, October 5: A transformational, story-driven series highlighting real women and men from the Dunamis Woman™ community and their journeys through healing, faith, relationships and personal transformation. Hosted by Professor Ari, the series pairs personal storytelling with insight from Dr. Dee, who helps viewers understand the lessons behind each journey and apply them to their own lives.

House of Healing — Premieres Thursday, October 10: The network's flagship unscripted transformational docu-series follows real women, not actors, as they enter an immersive healing retreat to confront the wounds, mindsets, relationships and life experiences that have kept them bound. Led by Dr. Dunamis Dee, each retreat takes viewers inside the raw conversations, challenging exercises, therapeutic coaching and deeply personal breakthroughs that unfold as women uncover what lies beneath the problems they thought they came to solve, revealing that sometimes, the problem you walk in talking about isn't the real problem at all.

The Professor Ari Podcast — Premieres Sunday, October 11: A thought-leadership podcast for ambitious women building what they believe God has called them to carry. Through conversations about identity, leadership, faith, endurance, income and impact, Fuller draws from her experience as a young executive and entrepreneur to explore what it takes to build with both purpose and capacity.

The Dr. Dunamis Dee Podcast — Premieres Sunday, October 11: Filmed from the stylish setting of Dr. Dee's' Dunamis Woman Boutique, the podcast introduces audiences to another side of the Visionary Founder through candid conversations about confidence, relationships, self-esteem, wisdom and the freedom to become unapologetically who they were created to be.

Dunamis Woman™ will formally introduce its new media chapter to the entertainment industry on Thursday, October 8, 2026, with the Dunamis Woman™ TV Network Upfront & Premiere in Atlanta. The invitation-only event will bring together entertainment executives, producers, media, creators, influencers, cultural tastemakers and business leaders for an exclusive "first look" at the network's inaugural programming slate. Guests will experience programming previews and trailers, a premiere screening of House of Healing, and a moderated conversation with Dr. Dee, Professor Ari and select participants from the series, followed by an industry networking reception.

Dunamis Woman™ TV Network programming is available for streaming on Roku, Amazon and Android TV as well as through the Dunamis Woman TV Network App on iPhone and Android. To subscribe, visit https://www.dunamiswomantv.com/checkout/subscribe/signup.

For press inquiries, or to schedule interviews with Dr. Dee and Professor Ari, contact dunamis@cnbettermedia.com.

Media interested in attending and covering the Dunamis Woman™ TV Network Upfront & Premiere may apply for credentials here: https://bit.ly/DunamisUpfrontCredentials 

ABOUT DUNAMIS WOMAN™

Dunamis Woman™ is a global transformational movement committed to helping women heal emotionally, grow spiritually and walk boldly in their God-given authority. Rooted in the Greek word "dunamis," meaning miraculous power, the organization equips women to restore identity, strengthen faith, build legacy and live whole from the inside out through transformational teaching, leadership development, educational resources, community experiences and live events. With a growing international community of more than 125,000 women, Dunamis Woman™ continues to inspire a generation of women determined to move beyond survival and into purposeful, legacy-driven living. For more information, visit www.dunamis-woman.com and follow @DunamisWoman on Instagram, Facebook, YouTube and X.

The launch builds on Askew's years of experience in film and entertainment. As President of For Us By Us Studios, he has worked alongside J Alexander Martin, Co-founder and CEO of FUBU Network, to develop entertainment and content initiatives for over two years.

As Founder and CEO of PrimeTime Productions TV, Askew is expanding his focus on creating original programming for today's evolving streaming marketplace. His existing relationship within the FUBU Network ecosystem gives him a rare dual advantage: a direct pipeline to air on FUBU Network, bypassing the pitch-and-license cycle most producers must navigate, plus the entertainment relationships built over his career to place a show elsewhere if there's a stronger fit for its niche or genre.

"PrimeTime Productions TV is a natural progression of the work I have been doing in entertainment," said Askew. "My experience as President of For Us By Us Studios has allowed me to understand the importance of compelling original programming. With PrimeTime Productions TV, we are focused on creating entertaining content featuring strong personalities, unique stories and ideas that connect with audiences."
